_comment: Notification config for .claude/hooks/route_subagent.py. Toast notifications work without this file. Email is opt-in.
_setup_for_email: 3. Set the password as an environment variable - the hook reads it from the env var named in 'smtp_password_env'
4. For Gmail: enable 2FA, generate an app password at https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords, use that as the password (NOT your normal password)
5. Test from PowerShell: $env:GOLFIN_NOTIFY_PASSWORD='abcd efgh ijkl mnop'; python .claude/hooks/route_subagent.py
6. Make the env var permanent via System Properties > Environment Variables, or load it in your PowerShell profile
